## Definition of done (CLAUDE.md)

- [ ] `make check` green (exit code read, output not piped)
- [ ] Visual-check on touched screens, light and dark (or "no UI change")
- [ ] `spec-reviewer` run for a HAB feature (or "not a feature")
- [ ] Deviations appended to `docs/backlog.md`; "As built" note in the spec section
- [ ] Comments say why only: no restating, banners, history, spec versions or ticket IDs
- [ ] No secrets, env values, logs or generated output; no attribution lines in commits
